items.markdown:
For a two-week island hopping trip, focus on either the **Andaman Sea** (November–April) for dramatic limestone cliffs or the **Gulf of Thailand** (May–October) for year-round reliability . The Andaman Coast is the most popular route, offering a perfect mix of bustling beaches, secluded bays, and world-class snorkeling.[](https://www.geekyexplorer.com/thailand-island-hopping-guide/) [[1]](https://www.geekyexplorer.com/thailand-island-hopping-guide/)[[2]](https://www.cantravelwilltravel.com/2-week-thailand-island-hopping-itinerary/)[[3]](https://thecoloursofthailand.com/explore-thailand/train-travel-in-thailand-scenic-journeys-to-the-sea/)[[4]](https://www.smileythaitravel.com/southern-thailand-beaches-islands/island-hopping-with-a-week-in-phuket-aphu15)[[5]](https://travelynnfamily.com/thai-island-hopping-with-kids/)

The Ultimate 2-Week Andaman Coast Itinerary

**Days 1–4: Phuket** 

- **Arrive:** Fly into Phuket International Airport (HKT).
- **Base yourself:** Stay in areas like Kata Noi Beach or Surin.
- **Activities:** Explore Phuket Old Town , visit the Big Buddha, and take a day trip to the Similan Islands for world-class diving.[](https://www.kotravellers.com/a-2-week-itinerary-in-thailand/) [[1]](https://www.kotravellers.com/a-2-week-itinerary-in-thailand/)[[2]](https://www.helenabradbury.com/blog-1/2-week-itinerary-krabi-phuket-phi-phi)[[3]](https://iyc.com/thailand/)[[4]](https://www.findingtheuniverse.com/10-day-thailand-itinerary/)

**Days 5–7: Koh Phi Phi** 

- **Transit:** Take a 1.5-hour ferry from Rassada Pier to Koh Phi Phi.
- **Activities:** Hike to the Phi Phi Viewpoint and take a sunrise long-tail boat to Maya Bay and Pi Leh Lagoon.[](https://www.kotravellers.com/a-2-week-itinerary-in-thailand/) [[1]](https://www.helenabradbury.com/blog-1/2-week-itinerary-krabi-phuket-phi-phi)[[2]](https://www.traveltomtom.net/destinations/asia/thailand/thailand-island-hopping-itinerary)[[3]](https://bridgesandballoons.com/how-to-get-to-koh-lanta/)

**Days 8–11: Krabi (Ao Nang & Railay Beach)** 

- **Transit:** Take a 1.5-hour ferry from Phi Phi to Ao Nang or Railay Beach.
- **Activities:** Rock climbing, relaxing on Phra Nang Cave Beach, and taking an island-hopping tour to Koh Poda and the Hong Islands.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FXzSozqf18A&vl=en&t=1042) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FXzSozqf18A&vl=en&t=1042)[[2]](https://www.cntraveler.com/story/the-ultimate-two-week-itinerary-for-thailand)

**Days 12–14: Koh Lanta** 

- **Transit:** Catch a speedboat or minivan/ferry combo (about 1.5 hours) south to Koh Lanta.
- **Activities:** Enjoy the laid-back vibe, explore the beaches of Mu Ko Lanta National Park, and dive the local coral reefs.
- **Depart:** Take a speedboat to the mainland, then a shuttle or taxi back to Krabi Airport (KBV) or Phuket for your flight home.[[1]](https://sweetlifelanta.com/getting-here)[[2]](https://www.theworldtrippers.com/asia/thailand/)[[3]](https://postcardsbyhannah.com/thailand-island-hopping-itinerary-10-days-krabi-koh-yao-noi-koh-lanta/)[[4]](https://www.thetimes.com/travel/destinations/asia-travel/thailand/best-thailand-islands-3qqhb9d55)[[5]](https://www.kayak.co.uk/news/thailand-itinerary/)

Essential Island-Hopping Tips

- **Booking:** Use platforms like 12Go to compare and book your ferries and overland transfers online in advance.
- **Weather:** Avoid the Andaman Coast during the heavy monsoon season from May to October, as boat services are frequently canceled.
- **Luggage:** Bring a rugged backpack instead of a wheeled suitcase. Navigating sandy beaches and transferring between long-tail boats is significantly harder with rolling luggage.[](https://travelynnfamily.com/thai-island-hopping-with-kids/) [[1]](https://travelynnfamily.com/thai-island-hopping-with-kids/)
